about: Status of each milestone for the progress bars in README.md (docs/roadmap/progress-dark.svg and progress-light.svg).

status is done, in-progress or planned. A milestone with an item list shows 'x of y': x counts the items with done: true, y counts all items. A milestone in progress needs an item list. A done milestone shows a full bar, a planned one an empty bar.
A milestone counts as done once its last release is published: M6 with 0.6.0, M7 with 0.7.5. Their item lists are in the history of this file.
A milestone stays planned until it has an item list of its own; work merged into main but not yet released does not count as done.

To update: edit this file, run 'node tools/roadmap/render-progress.mjs', commit the JSON, both SVGs and README.md. CI runs the script with --check and fails when the committed files differ from its output.
